title: Búnkers del Carmel · Turó de la Rovira
description: The surprise among Barcelona's places (docs/places/bunkers.md): the anti-aircraft battery's gun pits on the hilltop at sunset, the shacks' ruins, dry grass and pines, people on the parapets, and the whole real city below to the sea, with her castle far off on Trinitat Vella.
